run_dataset: run a dataset of benchmark scenarios with a specified model and configuration options
run_scenarios: run preprocessed scenarios using the MultiScenarioRunner and return validation results
multiply_scenarios_iterator: multiply a scenarios iterator to run each scenario N times with deep copies
preprocess_scenarios_iterator: preprocess loaded scenarios by applying judge configuration and validation settings from config
serialize_scenarios_iterator: serialize scenarios to JSON strings for pickling in a multi-process run
